en.onboarding.region.label: First-run guide
en.onboarding.title: Getting started
en.onboarding.subtitle: Three checks to confirm this console can see real data. This card sits in the page flow — it never covers the console and you can skip it at any time.
en.onboarding.steps.label: Three first-run checks
en.onboarding.action.open-models.aria: Open model settings to save an API key
en.onboarding.foot.note: Stays in the page flow — the console below is always clickable; the guide never blocks navigation.
en.onboarding.step.health.title: Confirm the daemon is online
en.onboarding.step.health.unhealthy: The daemon answered with status “{status}” — not healthy. Version {version} · port {port}
en.onboarding.step.health.offline: Not connected — /healthz did not answer, so version and port cannot be reported.
en.onboarding.step.health.hint: If this stays offline: make sure the local daemon service is running, then press “Check again”. Still failing? Open Settings → Diagnostics.
en.onboarding.step.models.title: Configure a model
en.onboarding.step.models.unknown: Cannot read the model list right now — no counts are shown.
en.onboarding.step.models.ready: {models} model(s) registered · {readyProviders} provider(s) with a saved API key
en.onboarding.step.models.no-key: No usable model yet: no provider has a saved API key. Save the key, then press “Test connection”.
en.onboarding.step.models.no-model: A provider has a key but no model is registered yet. Add a model in model settings.
en.onboarding.step.models.hint: Model settings is where providers, API keys and the “Test connection” button live.
en.onboarding.step.alerts.title: Look at the first alert
en.onboarding.step.alerts.unavailable: Alert data is unavailable right now — the alerts API did not answer. No count is shown.
en.onboarding.step.alerts.has: {total} alert(s) stored — open the alert list to read them.
en.onboarding.step.alerts.empty: No alerts yet. Let collection run for a while, then come back — nothing is invented here.
en.onboarding.step.alerts.hint: Only real alerts from the local daemon are shown; an empty list stays empty.

zh-CN.onboarding.region.label: 首次使用引导
zh-CN.onboarding.title: 先做三步确认
zh-CN.onboarding.subtitle: 三步确认这个控制台能看到真实数据。本卡片位于页面正常布局里，不会覆盖界面，随时可以跳过。
zh-CN.onboarding.steps.label: 首次使用三步检查
zh-CN.onboarding.help.open: 重新打开首次使用引导
zh-CN.onboarding.action.recheck.aria: 重新检测守护进程连接
zh-CN.onboarding.action.open-models.aria: 打开模型设置以保存 API Key
zh-CN.onboarding.foot.note: 本卡片在正常布局里，下方主界面始终可点，引导不会阻挡导航。
zh-CN.onboarding.step.health.title: 确认守护进程在线
zh-CN.onboarding.step.health.online: 已连接 · /healthz {status} · 版本 {version} · 端口 {port}
zh-CN.onboarding.step.health.degraded: 已连接但处于降级状态 · /healthz {status} · 版本 {version} · 端口 {port}
zh-CN.onboarding.step.health.unhealthy: 守护进程返回了“{status}”，不是健康状态。版本 {version} · 端口 {port}
zh-CN.onboarding.step.health.offline: 未连接——/healthz 没有响应，因此版本与端口都读不到。
zh-CN.onboarding.step.health.hint: 一直连不上时：确认本机守护进程服务正在运行，然后点“重新检测”。仍失败请到 设置 → 诊断 查看。
zh-CN.onboarding.step.models.title: 配置模型
zh-CN.onboarding.step.models.unknown: 当前读不到模型列表——不显示任何数字。
zh-CN.onboarding.step.models.ready: 已登记 {models} 个模型 · {readyProviders} 个 provider 已保存 API Key
zh-CN.onboarding.step.models.no-key: 还没有可用模型：没有 provider 保存过 API Key。先保存密钥，再点“测试连通”。
zh-CN.onboarding.step.models.no-model: 已有 provider 保存了密钥，但还没有登记模型。请到模型设置里添加。
zh-CN.onboarding.step.models.hint: provider、API Key 与“测试连通”按钮都在模型设置里。
zh-CN.onboarding.step.alerts.title: 看第一条告警
zh-CN.onboarding.step.alerts.unavailable: 当前读不到告警数据——告警接口没有响应，因此不显示条数。
zh-CN.onboarding.step.alerts.has: 已存 {total} 条告警——打开告警列表查看。
zh-CN.onboarding.step.alerts.empty: 还没有告警。等采集跑一会儿再来看看——这里不会编造数据。
zh-CN.onboarding.step.alerts.hint: 只展示本地守护进程的真实告警；空列表就保持为空。
